text: APPROVE. The extraction preserves the logic and ordering: the per-job `continue` paths become early returns of an empty list that is added to `unused`, `inheriting` is still mutated through the shared reference, and the top-level grant loop moves verbatim. Complexity drops well under 15, since the original method keeps only the loops and one guard while each helper has a few branches. I could not confirm the build from the diff alone, but the helper signatures reuse the same tuple-list types as the surrounding code, so nothing suggests a warning or error.
